children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Understand the Go workspace, request path, submodules, and ownership boundaries before changing code.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Desired state belongs in CRD spec; observed state and conditions belong to controllers.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: The workspace joins runtime components, shared libraries, optional services, packaging, e2e infrastructure, and two submodules.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: go.work joins operator, API, agent, shared Go modules, MCP, and tests.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: web is React; charts and deploy own packaging and local orchestration.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: modules and website are separately versioned gitlink repositories.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Browser, API, Kubernetes, operator, workloads, and agent form distinct contracts with different failure modes.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Browser → API uses same-origin REST, SSE, and WebSockets.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: API writes CRDs; operator reconciles workloads, storage, and status.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: API/operator reach the agent for console, files, logs, actions, and hooks.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Put policy in auth/RBAC/scope/audit, desired state in APIs, shared security invariants in libraries, and UI visuals in Pencil first.
